name: Quinyx
summary: Quinyx publishes no prices: the pricing page asks buyers to share requirements and wait for contact, so cost is quote only. Managers can build schedules by hand, semi-automatically or fully automatically, with shifts assigned by availability and skills. The privacy page claims GDPR compliance and names Sweden as the main establishment.

facts.text: The pricing page shows no dollar amounts and asks buyers to describe what they need so Quinyx can contact them.
The privacy page says Quinyx complies with GDPR and names Sweden's IMY as its lead supervisory authority, but it does not state where data is hosted.
The Employee Hub page describes a mobile-first app for teams, but it does not describe shift swapping or availability, which appear on the scheduling page.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: No plan names or prices are published
